newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Supreme Defence Council, chaired by president Emil Constantinescu, started session. The agenda included several draft laws and a full report on Constantinescu's visit to Poland.
* Constantinescu urged police to be firm in its fight against corruption and organised crime, during meeting with police officials on their annual activity report.
* Romania's crime rate rose in 1996, police chief, General Costica Voicu, said. Last year police investigated some 211,000 people allegedy involved in 320,000 criminal cases.
* Ex-President Ion Iliescu was elected head of the leftist Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) at the opening of the party's national conference. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
